description: Extract tables from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or HTML to typed JSON, from a URL, a local file path or inline content. Each visible table returns columns, column_types (number, currency, percent, date, boolean, string) and typed rows; as_records adds row objects. Hidden sheets, rows and text are never included; cells carrying prompt injections are replaced and listed in removed. No tables found returns 422, not charged. Max 3 MB. Paid x402 $0.004 USDC on Base; only successful extractions are charged.

as_records.description: Also return rows as objects keyed by column name

content.description: Inline HTML or Markdown containing tables

filename.description: File name with extension, helps format detection

header.description: First row of each table is column names (default true)

path.description: Local file path (read by this MCP server on your machine)

name: docread_tables
